newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telesp cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telesp cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst Rizwan Ali said on Thursday he had cut his rating for Brazilian telecommunications company Telesp to neutral from attractive.
-- Telesp "continues to reflect positive investor sentiment on the regulatory progress occurring in Brazil," Ali wrote in an analysis.

-- "Nonetheless, we believe most of the good news is already priced in to" Telesp. "Accordingly, it has recently reached our target price, leading us to downgrade our rating from attractive to neutral."
-- Telesp was off four to 234 in Sao Paulo.
